thesis: Heliod manufactures a resource nobody at the table prices - cards in your opponents' hands - converts it into a cost discount, one-sided draw, Treasure and life loss, and spends the turns that buys casting Approach of the Second Sun twice.

stages.label: WHAT PAYS FOR {6}{W} TWICE
stages.what_it_does:
32 of the deck's 33 land copies sit here, in 17 entries (Mikokoro is placed in ignition), plus eight rocks and cost-reducers. The bill this stage exists to pay is Approach's, twice: {6}{W} is seven mana and the deck has to find it on two separate turns. goldfish mean_available_mana_by_turn crosses 7 between turn 8 (6.966) and turn 9 (7.612), and that is with the commander's discount switched OFF in the model.

Mana, not cards, is the binding constraint. benchmark missed_land_drop_rate 0.2532 with turn six the worst; land_drop_hit_rate falls 0.729 / 0.603 / 0.540 across turns four to six. Colour is short of the deck's own targets: mana_analysis, as read by the strategic frame, gives 25 W and 26 U sources against source_targets of 36 each, and lands-only on-curve probability of 0.610 W / 0.639 U.

Three cards here are not mana in the ordinary sense. Pearl Medallion and Sapphire Medallion reduce cost rather than produce it, which is why the map files them away from the other rocks. Decanter of Endless Water and Reliquary Tower carry "You have no maximum hand size", the clause Kefnet the Mindful and Psychosis Crawler both read. Eiganjo and Otawara are counted here for the mana they tap for, but each is also a channel answer discarded from hand, and neither is counted in the deck's 21 answer cards.

evidence.note: 17 of 25 in Mana; 6 rocks in city-2 Ramp; Pearl and Sapphire Medallion in city-0 Bodies
deck-facts roles: Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Sol Ring, Talisman of Progress, Thought Vessel, Decanter of Endless Water carry ramp:rock; Pearl and Sapphire Medallion carry ramp:cost-reduction only

stages.label: THE GIFT - THE TABLE STARTS DRAWING
stages.what_it_does:
The first thing that has to happen, and the cheapest. Ten permanents hand the whole table extra cards; the resource every later stage reads - "a card an opponent drew this turn" - does not exist until one of them resolves. It is the earliest and most reliable declared component in the file: assembled in 0.92 of goldfish games (0.97 with tutors), 0.828 by turn six, mean turn 2.461. Eleven cards deep, so no single point of failure and no tutor needed to start.

Two placements differ from the declared component. Mikokoro, Center of the Sea is counted here rather than in mana - it is a colourless land whose "{2}, {T}: Each player draws a card" is what the deck wants from it. Enlightened Tutor is added here: it fetches Howling Mine, Font of Mythos, Temple Bell or Dictate of Kruphix onto the top, and it cannot find Approach (artifact or enchantment only). Scrawling Crawler is in the declared component and is placed in output instead, because its drain is the louder half.

The Second Doctor converts generosity into peace directly: each opponent who takes the card "can't attack you or permanents you control during their next turn". Forced Fruition is the one that can kill you - seven cards to a combo seat per spell they cast.

evidence.note: 9 of 11 in Card Flow; Mikokoro in city-1 Mana, Enlightened Tutor in city-0 Bodies

deck-facts roles: Temple Bell, Faerie Mastermind, Prosperity, Skyscribing, Scrawling Crawler are the only draw:wheel cards; the taxonomy has no pattern at all for Howling Mine, Font of Mythos, Dictate of Kruphix, Forced Fruition or Ghostly Prison, which is why the gift is invisible to roles

stages.label: YOUR OWN CARD FLOW, AND THE ONLY ROUTE BACK
stages.what_it_does:
What keeps the deck running once the table is drawing: eight cards that turn mana into cards for you, plus the two tutors that can actually find the win.

Alhammarret's Archive and Teferi's Ageless Insight double every draw after the first in each draw step - under the gift that is a multiplier on a stream already switched on. The declared component "Heliod down with an asymmetric card engine" (assembled 0.787, 0.581 by turn six) groups them with Rhystic Study and Consecrated Sphinx; they are split out here because they read YOUR draws, not your opponents', which is a different trigger and a different job. The five X-draw spells - Braingeyser, Stroke of Genius, Prosperity, Skyscribing, Mathemagics - are the mana sink, and three of them draw the whole table, feeding the same turn's discount. Dig Through Time delves, so its printed eight overstates what you pay.

ENUMERATED, because the declaration gets this wrong: of the 99, only Mystical Tutor (instant or sorcery) and Long-Term Plans (any card, third from the top) can find Approach of the Second Sun. Enlightened Tutor is artifact-or-enchantment. Drift of Phantasms transmutes for mana value 3; Approach is 7. Walking Ballista, which the declared "Win condition access" component counts as a fourth member, is neither - see proposed_goldfish_edits.

evidence.note: 6 of 10 in Card Flow; Braingeyser, Stroke of Genius (city-3) split from Mystical Tutor, Long-Term Plans, Dig Through Time and Braingeyser's neighbours in city-0 Bodies
deck-facts roles: only Drift of Phantasms and Long-Term Plans carry tutor:unrestricted, and Drift cannot reach Approach at mana value 7

stages.label: THE ASYMMETRY LAYER - SIX CARDS, ONE TRIGGER
stages.what_it_does:
The engine proper. The gift is symmetric and therefore not card advantage; these six make it one-sided, and they do it by reading the same event and paying it out in different currencies. Heliod, the Warped Eclipse: "Spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each card your opponents have drawn this turn", plus flash on everything you own. Consecrated Sphinx: two cards on every opponent draw. Faerie Mastermind: one on each opponent's second draw each turn. Smothering Tithe: a Treasure per opponent draw unless they pay {2}. Rhystic Study and Mystic Remora bill casts rather than draws, which is the same shape against a different clock.

THE FINDING: the commander is a multiplier here, not the ignition, and the measurement is unambiguous. Over 120 Forge games Heliod resolved in 68 of 120 (resolved_rate 0.567), averaged 0.69 casts and first resolved on global turn 34.5 - while the deck took 20 of its 27 wins with Approach. The engine ran without him more often than with him. `model-coverage` reports his only modelled channel as bodies, so every goldfish mana figure above is measured with the discount OFF and is a floor.

There is no `fodder` stage in this deck. Nothing here is converted by being spent: the resource the engine eats is manufactured on the opponents' side of the table and never enters your hand.
cards: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

evidence.note: 4 of 6 in Card Flow; Heliod in city-0 Bodies, Smothering Tithe in city-2 Ramp

deck-facts roles: Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Consecrated Sphinx, Faerie Mastermind and Smothering Tithe all carry draw:engine, but so do Arcane Denial, Psychosis Crawler, Scrawling Crawler and The Second Doctor - the role does not separate a converter from a draw spell

stages.label: WHAT IT PRODUCES, AND HOW LITTLE
stages.what_it_does:
Six cards, and the measured verdict on them is the most useful line in this model. Psychosis Crawler drains each opponent 1 on every card YOU draw and has power and toughness equal to your hand size - under the gift, plus the three "no maximum hand size" clauses (Reliquary Tower, Decanter of Endless Water, The Second Doctor), it is a large body that scales with the deck's primary axis, which is a better reading of it than "punisher". Scrawling Crawler drains an opponent per draw and hands the whole table an upkeep card, so it is half an ignition piece. Four X-cards leave a permanent behind: Secure the Wastes, Walking Ballista, Hangarback Walker (which dies into flying Thopters) and Mikaeus, the Lunarch.

Read the medians. Over 120 Forge games heliod dealt combat damage to players with mean 4.11 and MEDIAN 0.5; noncombat damage mean 1.68, MEDIAN 0.0; commander damage reached 21 in zero games; and heliod was credited with 7 eliminations across the whole run (baylen-tokens 4, abaddon 2, giada-angels 1). This is a value and blocking layer, not a clock. The pilot cut Iron Maiden, Viseling and Ebony Owl Netsuke on exactly that evidence, and the declared "Draw-trigger punisher" component - two cards, assembled 0.366, 0.256 by turn six - is what remains of the axis.

evidence.note: 4 of 6 in Bodies; both Crawlers in city-3 Card Flow
deck-facts roles: Psychosis Crawler and Scrawling Crawler are the only two cards in the 99 carrying wincon:drain

stages.label: THE 26 CARDS THAT BUY THE TURNS
stages.what_it_does:
The largest stage by a distance, 26 of 85 entries, and its whole job is to survive to a seven-drop you must cast twice. Four layers, each with its own assembly figure.

COUNTERS (8, two of them free): Counterspell, Swan Song, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Dovin's Veto, Arcane Denial, Archmage's Charm, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship. "Free or cheap interaction held" assembles 0.843, 0.707 by turn six - but goldfish interaction_castable is 0.626 at turn six against 0.927 in hand, so holding it and paying for it are different problems.

REMOVAL (7): Path to Exile, Swords to Plowshares, Disenchant, Cathar Commando, Day of Judgment, Supreme Verdict, Cyclonic Rift.

THE FORT (6): Propaganda, Ghostly Prison and Archangel of Tithes tax attackers - assembled 0.487, only 0.355 by turn six, the least reliable of the four defensive components. Angelic Wall, Drift of Phantasms, Kefnet the Mindful and Archangel are this stage's share of the six-card flier-blocker component (Consecrated Sphinx and Faerie Mastermind are the other two and sit in conversion), 0.750 assembled. Kefnet carries a condition the declaration ignores: he cannot block below seven cards in hand.

COMMANDER INSURANCE (5): Lightning Greaves, Guardian of Faith, Karametra's Blessing, Teferi's Protection, and Leyline of Anticipation, which duplicates the flash grant without needing him. Assembled 0.680, 0.526 by turn six.

The last two layers exist because of one measurement: 39 of heliod's 74 eliminations came from giada-angels and 53 were dealt as damage, against combat_damage_taken mean 36.08, median 24.0.

evidence.note: 11 in Bodies, 7 in city-4 Card Flow II, 6 in city-5 Interaction, Kefnet in city-3 Card Flow, An Offer You Can't Refuse in city-2 Ramp - five cities for one job
benchmark response: answer_cards 21, answer_share 0.25, 6 of 15 classes covered; the 5 remaining cards in this stage (the three taxers and two Wall-type blockers) carry no answer role at all

stages.label: ONE CARD
stages.what_it_does:
Approach of the Second Sun, cast twice from hand. The first cast gains 7 life and puts the card seventh from the top; the second wins outright. It is 20 of the deck's 27 wins over 120 Forge games - the run record's own tally of won_by "effect of 'Approach of the Second Sun'". The other 7 read "all opponents have lost": attrition, which has no card of its own, and which is why this stage names exactly one. Mean finishing position 2.319 over 94 ranked games (16 firsts, 43 seconds, 24 thirds, 11 fourths); win rate 0.252, CI95 [0.180, 0.342], against a four-seat null of 0.225 that the interval contains.

Verified stack 002 settles the whole skill. The win is checked during Approach's resolution as a spell effect, not a state-based action, so the only window to stop it is while Approach is on the stack before all players pass priority; once resolution begins nobody has priority again. The first casting still counts although the card was shuffled back into the library, because the condition tracks a casting event in game history rather than a card object. Two caveats the stack states itself: Swan Song answers a spell only, not an activated or triggered ability; and 002's board names Ancient Tomb, which this list no longer runs - the ruling does not depend on it.

This is a ONE-finisher deck, and the pilot's standing constraint against two-card infinites rules out the usual second route. bracket_report.json now reads two_card_infinites: 0.

evidence.note: checker.verdict pass; the win is checked mid-resolution and the only interaction window is on the stack
Approach sits in Card Flow with the draw engine, not with the tutors that find it

evidence.id: Approach of the Second Sun + Mystical Tutor
evidence.note: the single contained Commander Spellbook line, bracket 3, produces 'Win the game'; it is a candidate, and stack 002 is what makes this one a fact

via: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
lines.note: Howling Mine gives each opponent one extra card in their draw step; Heliod's back face then reads 'cost {1} less for each card your opponents have drawn this turn'. Three opponents drawing two apiece is a {6} discount on your turn. NOT modelled by the goldfish - model-coverage gives Heliod only the bodies channel - so every mana figure in this artifact is a floor.

Font of Mythos gives each player two additional cards in their draw step; Consecrated Sphinx draws you two on every opponent draw. Six opponent draws a round cycle becomes twelve cards for you. Claim, not fact: no stack has resolved this pairing.
Temple Bell's activation makes each player draw, so each opponent must pay {2} or hand you a Treasure. The mana route from the gift back to the {6}{W} bill. Claim, not fact.

Psychosis Crawler triggers on YOUR draws, not your opponents' - Temple Bell is one of the gift pieces that draws you a card too, which is what connects them. Measured value of this whole route: noncombat damage median 0.0 over 120 games.

Scrawling Crawler triggers on OPPONENT draws, which is the other half of the pair and the half Howling Mine feeds. The declared 'Engine + punisher assembled' component prices the two-piece at 0.328 assembled, 0.196 by turn six - the deck's least reliable declared pairing.

via: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
lines.note: CLAIM, and an unsettled one: the back face reduces generic cost, so a discount should let you choose a larger X on Stroke of Genius, Braingeyser, Prosperity, Skyscribing or Mathemagics. Whether that is how the cost is computed is in open_questions for resolve-stack; nothing on disk settles it.
Sphinx's 'draw two cards' is two draw events, and the Archive replaces each draw after the first in a draw step - so an opponent's draw becomes four cards, not two. Claim: no stack has resolved it.
{6}{W} twice is fourteen mana across two turns, and goldfish mean_available_mana crosses 7 only between turn 8 (6.966) and turn 9 (7.612). This is the arrow the deck's whole mana base exists to draw.
Stack 002's game history is exactly this route - Mystical Tutor cast at an end step put Approach on top, it was drawn, and the second cast from hand resolved as a win. Checker verdict pass.

Stack 002 step 4: Swan Song held with {U} up counters the opponent's counter and Approach still resolves. The stack states the limit itself - Swan Song answers an enchantment, instant or sorcery SPELL, and cannot answer an activated or triggered ability.

via: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
lines.note: The insurance package was added because the commander is fragile: resolved in 68 of 120 games, 0.69 casts on the mean, first resolution at global turn 34.5. deck_versions v1.1.0's note prices the change against 'a 45% removal rate' from 119 measured departures; that decomposition is not on disk in this deck's artifacts and is repeated here as the version's stated rationale, not as a figure I re-derived.

map_disagreements.why: The single most valuable disagreement in this deck. Six cards read the SAME input - an opponent drew a card, or cast a spell - and each states a different OUTPUT, so the map, which is built from card text, files them by what they produce. Smothering Tithe reads as ramp because it says Treasure. Heliod reads as a creature because his type line is one. Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Consecrated Sphinx and Faerie Mastermind read as draw. No card in the group says what the group is for, so this layer is invisible in card text and cannot be seen by a reader looking at the constellation.

26 cards across five cities - the map splits them by HOW they answer (counter text, destroy text, a body, a Treasure rider on An Offer You Can't Refuse) while the deck uses all of them for one job: buy turns until you can cast a seven-drop twice. Kefnet the Mindful lands in Card Flow because his activated ability draws, which is the least important thing he does here.

Pearl Medallion and Sapphire Medallion are cost reduction, not production, so the map puts them with the white spells and the X-creatures rather than with the rocks. In this deck they do the rocks' job - shave the bill on a colour-heavy curve - which is also how goldfish_targets counts them.

Nine of eleven cluster cleanly, which is unusual. The two strays are structural rather than semantic: Mikokoro is a land and its text is mostly a mana ability, and Enlightened Tutor is a search, so it sits with the other tutors regardless of what it fetches in this 99.

No disagreement, but the address is worth naming: Approach sits in Card Flow with the draw engine - the map read it on 'gain 7 life' and 'seventh from the top' - while Mystical Tutor and Long-Term Plans, the only two cards that find it, sit in Bodies. The deck's win and its route to the win have different addresses.

open_questions.question: Does Heliod, the Warped Eclipse's cost reduction let you choose a larger X on Braingeyser, Stroke of Genius, Prosperity, Skyscribing, Mathemagics, Secure the Wastes, Walking Ballista, Hangarback Walker or Mikaeus, the Lunarch - and if so, is X chosen before or after the reduction applies?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The declared component 'An X-spell finisher drawn (the mana sink the discount pays for)' assembles 0.790 and its whole justification is this interaction. Nothing on disk tests it, and the conversion -> fuel line in this artifact is a claim resting on it.

open_questions.question: While Lightning Greaves is equipped to Heliod, can you still target him with Karametra's Blessing or Guardian of Faith's enters trigger, and is moving the Greaves off in response possible at instant speed?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Greaves grants shroud, which stops your own targeting; equip is sorcery-speed. If two of the five commander-insurance slots are mutually exclusive with a third while equipped, the 0.680 assembly figure for that component overstates what the pilot can actually do in a removal window.

open_questions.question: Can the second Approach of the Second Sun be cast at an opponent's end step under Heliod's flash grant or Leyline of Anticipation, and is Fierce Guardianship's alternative cost live in that window when Heliod himself is the commander on the battlefield?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Stack 002 resolves the sorcery-speed cast on your own turn. The end-step cast is a different and better window - it spends the table's responses first - and the free-counter backup depends on the commander still being there, which the run says he is in 0.567 of games.

open_questions.question: No declared target measures the deck's actual win: Approach in hand AND seven mana available on two separate turns. Can the harness express a mana condition, or must the gap be recorded rather than modelled?
open_questions.why_it_matters: 'Win condition access' at 0.596 measures drawing one of four cards, one of which (Walking Ballista) cannot find or be the win. 20 of 27 measured wins are the second cast, and nothing in goldfish_targets.json prices whether the deck can pay for it.

open_questions.question: How many tutor and protection slots is a single 'you win the game' card worth in a four-player pod, and how should the one-window cast be timed against three potential responders?
open_questions.why_it_matters: strategic_frame.json's own gaps list says the strategy doc has NO section on alternate win conditions - the query returns 0.407 and nothing on topic. This deck's entire plan therefore has no home in the corpus, and the wincon stage has one card where threat-density asks for three to five.

proposed_goldfish_edits.target: Win condition access (Approach, or a tutor that can actually find a sorcery)
proposed_goldfish_edits.change: Remove 'Walking Ballista' from the any_of, leaving Approach of the Second Sun, Mystical Tutor and Long-Term Plans.
proposed_goldfish_edits.why: Walking Ballista is {X}{X}, an artifact creature that pings; it neither is the win condition nor searches for one, and the label's own test - 'a tutor that can actually find a sorcery' - excludes it. Enumerated over the 99: Mystical Tutor finds an instant or sorcery, Long-Term Plans finds any card, Enlightened Tutor is artifact-or-enchantment only, and Drift of Phantasms transmutes for mana value 3 against Approach's 7. The group is three cards, not four, which will move the 0.596 assembled figure down.

proposed_goldfish_edits.target: Draw-trigger punisher drawn (bills them for taking it)
proposed_goldfish_edits.change: Relabel, e.g. 'A Crawler drawn (a body that scales with the gift, and drains on the side)'. Membership unchanged.
proposed_goldfish_edits.why: The three cards the label was written for - Iron Maiden, Viseling, Ebony Owl Netsuke - are cut, after 116 castings across 120 games produced a MEDIAN of zero noncombat damage. What is left is Psychosis Crawler, whose live text in this deck is power and toughness equal to hand size under three no-maximum-hand-size effects, and Scrawling Crawler, which is half a gift permanent. The label describes a clock the deck no longer has, and a reader will price the 0.366 figure as one.

proposed_goldfish_edits.target: A body that can block a FLIER (39 of 53 eliminations came from the air)
proposed_goldfish_edits.change: Either drop 'Kefnet the Mindful' from the any_of, or state his condition in the label.
proposed_goldfish_edits.why: Kefnet 'can't attack or block unless you have seven or more cards in hand' (oracle text, cards.json). The harness has no hand-size condition, so counting him unconditionally credits a blocker that is sometimes not one, and the component's 0.750 assembled / 0.604 by turn six is the figure five new defensive slots were bought against. Dropping him takes the group from six cards to five.

notes: STALENESS, and it applies to every Forge figure in this artifact: sim run giada-angels-vs-baylen-tokens-vs-abaddon-n120 carries heliod seat decklist_sha256 decc32b080fe - v1.0.0 - and the record's own note says the games were played on the launch .dck. The current list is 214af3084f80 (v1.2.1). Fourteen cards have changed since, including every card named in the protection stage's fort and insurance layers. The 120 games are evidence about the deck that PRODUCED the change, not about the deck that resulted from it. Every goldfish, benchmark and bracket figure quoted here does match the current sha.

strategic_frame.json (same decklist sha) quotes three component figures that goldfish_metrics.json no longer holds: 0.935 for the table draw engine against 0.920, 0.334 for engine-plus-punisher against 0.328, and 0.679 for win-condition access against 0.596. This artifact uses goldfish_metrics.json throughout, via engine-facts. The frame appears to have been written against an earlier goldfish run.
